Agate.name: Agate
Agate.description: Banded brown and cream, cut from a geode and polished smooth.

Alabaster.name: Alabaster
Alabaster.description: Soft white stone, translucent at the edges. Carvers prize it more than jewellers do.

Ashen Hourglass.name: Ashen Hourglass
Ashen Hourglass.description: The ashes flow upward instead of down. When they reach the top, something small and long forgotten is often found nearby.

Azurite.name: Azurite
Azurite.description: Deep blue and crumbling, ground for pigment as often as it is worn.

Bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
Bloodstone.description: Dark green flecked with red, which the superstitious say is old blood.

Book of Shy Pages.name: Book of Shy Pages
Book of Shy Pages.description: Its words disappear when read aloud. If left alone, new notes appear in the margins.

Bottle of Ancient Rain.name: Bottle of Ancient Rain
Bottle of Ancient Rain.description: A tiny, silent storm swirls inside the glass. Touching the cork fills the air with the scent of rain falling on soil in some distant place.

Box of Last Losses.name: Box of Last Losses
Box of Last Losses.description: A shoebox-sized box. Opened, it holds the last petty thing its holder lost. Each time something comes back, something else of theirs goes missing.

Buckle of the Broken Promise.name: Buckle of the Broken Promise
Buckle of the Broken Promise.description: Its metal turns dull near people who once knew each other well. A sentence is engraved on the back, but its final word is missing.

Button from the Green Coat.name: Button from the Green Coat
Button from the Green Coat.description: A plain wooden button that reappears in the pocket of anyone who throws it away. In cold weather, it seems attached to a piece of invisible cloth.

Carnelian.name: Carnelian
Carnelian.description: Warm orange-red, glowing when held to a light.

Chrysoberyl.name: Chrysoberyl
Chrysoberyl.description: Yellow-green and hard enough to scratch almost anything it is set beside.

Chrysoprase.name: Chrysoprase
Chrysoprase.description: Apple-green and waxy, the brightest of the chalcedonies.

Clear-Sky Umbrella.name: Clear-Sky Umbrella
Clear-Sky Umbrella.description: It opens only when there are no clouds overhead. Beneath it, one can hear raindrops and muffled conversations from what sounds like a rain-soaked street.

Clock of the Motionless Hour.name: Clock of the Motionless Hour
Clock of the Motionless Hour.description: Its hands never advance, though its ticking quickens in certain corridors. The displayed time changes whenever the clock is given to someone else.

Coin of the Erased King.name: Coin of the Erased King
Coin of the Erased King.description: One side bears a crown; the other, a face deliberately scraped away. Sometimes it lands on its edge and remains standing far longer than it should.

Cold Ivory Comb.name: Cold Ivory Comb
Cold Ivory Comb.description: Its teeth never catch or tangle in hair. After it is used, a familiar melody lingers in the air, though no one can remember its words.

Compass of the Broken Circle.name: Compass of the Broken Circle
Compass of the Broken Circle.description: It draws perfect arcs but never completes a circle. The narrow gap always faces the same point on the horizon.

Crown of Dry Branches.name: Crown of Dry Branches
Crown of Dry Branches.description: Tiny buds appear on it during arguments and wither after an apology. No one recognizes the tree from which its branches came.

Curtain from the Closed Window.name: Curtain from the Closed Window
Curtain from the Closed Window.description: A translucent scrap of fabric that stirs even without wind. Held against a wall, it reveals a landscape that is not truly there.

Diamond.name: Diamond
Diamond.description: Small, colourless, and it throws white fire in candlelight.

Dragon Tooth Far Too Small.name: Dragon Tooth Far Too Small
Dragon Tooth Far Too Small.description: White, curved, and no larger than a fingernail. It becomes coated in soot whenever someone mentions hidden treasure.

Drowned Music Box.name: Drowned Music Box
Drowned Music Box.description: It makes no sound when opened, yet droplets of water seep from the wood. Nearby fish seem to follow a melody no one else can hear.

Emerald.name: Emerald
Emerald.description: Deep green, with the fine internal flaws no emerald is without.

Feather from a Bird Without a Sky.name: Feather from a Bird Without a Sky
Feather from a Bird Without a Sky.description: Blue on one side and black on the other. Near a flame, its shadow flaps its wings even while the feather remains still.

Frosted-Glass Hammer.name: Frosted-Glass Hammer
Frosted-Glass Hammer.description: It looks fragile, yet bears no cracks or chips. When struck against stone, it sounds like a knock from the other side of a door. In a fight it is a d4 weapon: after each attack made with it, roll the Die of Fate, and on a 1–3 it shatters. Striking stone never breaks it.

Garnet.name: Garnet
Garnet.description: Wine-dark red, cut to a long point at both ends.

Goblet of the Forgotten Toast.name: Goblet of the Forgotten Toast
Goblet of the Forgotten Toast.description: Any liquid poured into it takes on the aroma of a drink from the holder’s childhood. After the first sip, someone far away seems to raise a matching cup.

Gold Nugget.name: Gold Nugget
Gold Nugget.description: Raw gold the size of a thumb, picked out of the rock.

Golden Nail.name: Golden Nail
Golden Nail.description: It has no point and cannot be bent. Held near old timber, it releases the scent of a newly built house.

Helm of the Delayed Echo.name: Helm of the Delayed Echo
Helm of the Delayed Echo.description: Whatever its wearer says is spoken again, word for word, a few minutes later, from the spot where they said it. Some of the repeated sentences were never spoken.

Hematite.name: Hematite
Hematite.description: Iron-grey and mirror-bright, heavy for its size. Leaves a red streak when scratched.

Hungry Silver Spoon.name: Hungry Silver Spoon
Hungry Silver Spoon.description: Food tasted with it loses its scent. Its bowl bears the crest of a family that insists it never owned such an object.

Jasper.name: Jasper
Jasper.description: Opaque and brick-red, veined with darker threads.

Key to the Room That Isn’t There.name: Key to the Room That Isn’t There
Key to the Room That Isn’t There.description: A long key made of dark iron, always warm to the touch. Its handle bears a strange number—or perhaps a symbol—that no one can identify.

Killer Bee Honey.name: Killer Bee Honey
Killer Bee Honey.description: Dark honey from a Killer Bee hive. Each use heals 1d6 STR.

Lapis Lazuli.name: Lapis Lazuli
Lapis Lazuli.description: Night-blue, dusted with gold flecks of pyrite.

Letter Addressed to No One.name: Letter Addressed to No One
Letter Addressed to No One.description: Its seal remains unbroken, and the recipient’s name is blank. Even so, each person recognizes the handwriting as belonging to someone different.

Locket of Two Mornings.name: Locket of Two Mornings
Locket of Two Mornings.description: It contains two tiny images of the same field: one at sunrise, the other beneath thick fog. Occasionally, the sun moves from one image to the other.

Malachite.name: Malachite
Malachite.description: Green in concentric bands, like rings cut from a tree.

Map of Lost Streets.name: Map of Lost Streets
Map of Lost Streets.description: The alleys drawn upon it shift slightly whenever the parchment is folded. No city name appears anywhere on the map.

Mirror of the Third Figure.name: Mirror of the Third Figure
Mirror of the Third Figure.description: The reflection shows everyone nearby except the person holding it. On certain nights, an extra figure appears in the background.

Moonstone.name: Moonstone
Moonstone.description: Milk-white, and a blue light drifts under the surface.

Needle That Points Home.name: Needle That Points Home
Needle That Points Home.description: When placed on a flat surface, it slowly turns toward a particular direction. Different people insist it points toward different places.

New-Moon Salt.name: New-Moon Salt
New-Moon Salt.description: Black crystals kept in a small bone shaker. Beneath starlight, some grains arrange themselves into unknown constellations.

Night Gardener’s Gloves.name: Night Gardener’s Gloves
Night Gardener’s Gloves.description: They are covered in soil that cannot be brushed away. Seeds held in them tremble faintly, as though dreaming.

Notebook of Crossed-Out Names.name: Notebook of Crossed-Out Names
Notebook of Crossed-Out Names.description: Every page contains lists of names hidden beneath heavy ink. A single blank line remains at the bottom of the final page.

Obsidian.name: Obsidian
Obsidian.description: Black volcanic glass, and sharp wherever it has broken.

Onyx.name: Onyx
Onyx.description: Black banded with white, sawn flat for a signet.

Opal.name: Opal
Opal.description: Fire moves in it — green, orange, red — and none of it is fixed.

Pale-Skinned Drum.name: Pale-Skinned Drum
Pale-Skinned Drum.description: It trembles without making a sound whenever horses approach. After rainfall, a child-sized handprint appears upon its surface.

Portrait of the Unknown Relative.name: Portrait of the Unknown Relative
Portrait of the Unknown Relative.description: It depicts someone whose features seem vaguely familiar. The painted face ages with every full moon, while the rest of the portrait remains unchanged.

Pyrite.name: Pyrite
Pyrite.description: Brassy cubes that have been sold as gold more than once.

Quartz.name: Quartz
Quartz.description: A clear six-sided crystal, cold to hold.

Ring for the Missing Finger.name: Ring for the Missing Finger
Ring for the Missing Finger.description: Too large for any finger and too small for a wrist. The inside is scored with marks resembling scratches made by fingernails.

Rope of Eleven Knots.name: Rope of Eleven Knots
Rope of Eleven Knots.description: Each knot has a different texture. One knot always comes undone when counted, yet the total remains eleven.

Rose Quartz.name: Rose Quartz
Rose Quartz.description: Clouded pink, uncut, a whole fist of it.

Ruby.name: Ruby
Ruby.description: Blood-red and cut oval, the colour holding all the way through.

Sardonyx.name: Sardonyx
Sardonyx.description: Red and white in flat bands, meant to be carved through one layer into the next.

Single Velvet Shoe.name: Single Velvet Shoe
Single Velvet Shoe.description: It fits no foot properly. Left on the floor overnight, it is found at dawn covered in fresh mud.

Spinel.name: Spinel
Spinel.description: Bright red and faceted, and mistaken for a ruby by everyone but a jeweller.

Spinning Top That Wakes for Sleepers.name: Spinning Top That Wakes for Sleepers
Spinning Top That Wakes for Sleepers.description: It begins turning whenever someone nearby falls asleep. It stops just before they awaken and falls pointing toward them.

Star Sapphire.name: Star Sapphire
Star Sapphire.description: Blue, and a six-rayed star crosses the dome as the stone turns.

Stone with a Pulse.name: Stone with a Pulse
Stone with a Pulse.description: Smooth, heavy, and slightly warm. Pressed against the chest, its rhythm seems to follow a heart other than the holder’s own.

Tear-Embroidered Handkerchief.name: Tear-Embroidered Handkerchief
Tear-Embroidered Handkerchief.description: The cloth is always damp and smells faintly of lavender. Different initials appear in one corner depending on who holds it.

The Blind Seamstress’s Scissors.name: The Blind Seamstress’s Scissors
The Blind Seamstress’s Scissors.description: They cut cloth without leaving scraps behind. Threads severed by the blades later appear tied together somewhere else.

The Pilgrim’s Folding Chair.name: The Pilgrim’s Folding Chair
The Pilgrim’s Folding Chair.description: Far too light for its thick wooden frame. Anyone who sits in it briefly remembers a journey they may never have taken.

Three-Holed Flute.name: Three-Holed Flute
Three-Holed Flute.description: It produces four notes. The fourth is not exactly heard, yet small animals stop whatever they are doing when it is played.

Tiger Eye.name: Tiger Eye
Tiger Eye.description: Golden brown, and the sheen across it moves when the stone does.

Tourmaline.name: Tourmaline
Tourmaline.description: A teardrop that is pink at one end and green at the other.

Turquoise.name: Turquoise
Turquoise.description: Sky-blue veined with black, opaque and lightly porous.

Uneven Bone Die.name: Uneven Bone Die
Uneven Bone Die.description: It has seven faces but only six numbers. The unmarked face seems to turn upward whenever no one is watching.

Vial of Liquid Shadow.name: Vial of Liquid Shadow
Vial of Liquid Shadow.description: The dark substance inside moves against the tilt of the glass. At midday, the vial appears almost empty.

Warm-Bottomed Pouch.name: Warm-Bottomed Pouch
Warm-Bottomed Pouch.description: It feels empty, yet something small moves inside whenever it is closed. Opened suddenly, it contains nothing but a gray feather.

Whispering Violet Orb.name: Whispering Violet Orb
Whispering Violet Orb.description: Purple lights drift beneath its surface like creatures underwater. Anyone who watches it for too long feels that the whispers are close to forming their name.
